item.title: GitLab CI with Kubernetes Runners
item.description:
Overview

Designed and operated GitLab CI runners on Kubernetes with autoscaling and isolated workloads.

What I did

  • Deployed GitLab Runner using Helm
  • Integrated with Kubernetes executor
  • Tuned resource limits and concurrency
  • Secured runners using RBAC and namespaces

Stack

  • Kubernetes
  • GitLab CI
  • Helm
  • Docker
